docs.title: Music Game with C# and F
docs.text: This is a music rhythm game that uses both C# and F#.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository.
  2. Create new solution: dotnet new sln -n RhythmGameSystem; mkdir CoreSrc ShellSrc
  3. Build F# compilation library: cd CoreSrc; dotnet new classlib -lang "F#" -n RhythmGame.Core; cd ..
  4. Build UI system driver: cd ShellSrc; dotnet new console -n RhythmGame.Shell; cd ..
  5. Bind compilation project: dotnet sln add CoreSrc/RhythmGame.Core/RhythmGame.Core.fsproj; dotnet sln add ShellSrc/RhythmGame.Shell/RhythmGame.Shell.csproj; dotnet add ShellSrc/RhythmGame.Shell/RhythmGame.Shell.csproj reference CoreSrc/RhythmGame.Core/RhythmGame.Core.fsproj
  6. Compile and run the project: dotnet run --project ShellSrc/RhythmGame.Shell/RhythmGame.Shell.csproj
